03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill built around ytx, Swami's own command-line tool that wraps yt-dlp. One command (or one double-click on a Desktop icon) saves a video's transcript, chapters, and details into a folder, and Claude works from those files. Since version 1.2.0, both versions of ytx ship inside the skill: scripts/ytx for the Mac and scripts/ytx.ps1 for Windows.

By default Claude answers in chat: the video's title, channel, date, and length, then one short summary per chapter with clickable timestamps. On request it builds a vibe dashboard instead, and with comments added it pulls in the youtube-comments skill's threads.

Why it mattersClaude's cloud workspace can't reach youtube.com, and in Oct 2026 YouTube refused the Claude app's browser for transcripts (an empty transcript panel, errors, and empty caption files). Running ytx on Swami's own computer is the dependable way in.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • TranscriptSaves transcript.md: the title, channel, date, length, chapter list, and roughly 20-second paragraphs under chapter headings, with every [m:ss] stamp linked to that moment on YouTube, starting at 0:00.
  • One caption trackDownloads the video's details first, then asks YouTube for one caption track: the creator's English subtitles, else the original auto track en-orig, else en. If YouTube refuses one, it says why and tries the next. This avoids the HTTP 429 error that asking for every English track caused in Nov 2026.
  • Plain textAlso saves transcript.txt, the same transcript without links.
  • ChaptersSaves chapters.txt, one line per chapter with its time, title, and link, whenever the video has chapters.
  • CommentsWith ytx -c, also saves the full comment tree and comments-threaded.txt for the youtube-comments skill.
  • Chat summaryAnswers with a header line and one paragraph per chapter, each led by a linked timestamp. Without chapters, Claude makes its own sections from topic shifts and says so.
  • DashboardOn request, builds a vibe dashboard in the current vibe-dashboard format: the Search section, a video overview and chapter index with timestamp links, topic sections, any caveats, optional takeaways, a Mind Map, a Glossary, references, and an audio overview.
  • Copyright careGives a full verbatim transcript only for Swami's own videos and Zoom recordings. For anyone else's video it gives chapter links and summaries in Claude's own words.
  • Windowsytx.ps1 is a PowerShell port of ytx 1.2.0 with the same commands and output, plus an offline self-test against the Mac version's results. It was rebuilt from the Mac script and has never been run.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Clickable timesEvery timestamp, in the files and in Claude's answers, opens the video at that moment.
  • No API keyWorks with no YouTube account or API key.
  • Any lengthHandles long videos and Zoom recordings, grouped by chapter.
  • Comments tooAdds the complete comment tree in the same run when asked.
  • Own sectionsMakes its own sections from topic shifts when a video has no chapters.
  • Same outputMac and Windows versions write the same files.
  • Needs a computerytx runs on Swami's Mac or a Windows PC; Claude's cloud workspace and the app's browser can't get transcripts.
  • Captions neededIf the creator turned captions off, or a new upload has none yet, there is no transcript; Claude says so instead of guessing.
  • Auto-captionsAutomatic captions have garbled spots and cut-off phrases, so quotes from them are flagged as approximate.
  • Others' videosNo full transcript or verbatim section for someone else's video, only chapter links and summaries.
  • Site changesYouTube changes can break older yt-dlp versions until it is updated.
  • Windows untestedytx.ps1 1.2.0 was rebuilt from the Mac script after the 1.1.0 Windows file was lost, and has never been run on a real Windows PC.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. The skill runs only when asked and neither needs nor creates a scheduled task. The nightly "Skills dashboard nightly refresh" repackages its zip for GitHub but never runs it.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Browser refusedDon't try the Claude app's browser for the transcript: in Oct 2026 the panel stayed empty, get_transcript returned 400, and caption files came back empty.
  • Cloud can't reachClaude's cloud workspace can't reach youtube.com, so it can't download anything itself.
  • yt-dlp failedRun sudo yt-dlp -U (YouTube changes break old versions), then retry.
  • HTTP 429"HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests" on captions means YouTube refused the download. Check ytx -v: below 1.2.0, install 1.2.0 from the skill zip; on 1.2.0, wait 15 to 30 minutes and run ytx again.
  • Where to typeCommands go in Terminal (or PowerShell), not in the chat, and only the command itself, without words like "run". ytx URL doesn't ask about comments; only the Desktop icon asks.
  • Harmless warning"No supported JavaScript runtime" is harmless for captions, chapters, and comments.
  • No captions"No English captions found" means captions are off or not ready yet (new uploads can take hours).
  • Don't searchNever use find ~ to look for the files: it can run for minutes and stall on macOS privacy prompts. Everything is in ~/yt/<video-id>/.
  • No recipesClaude gives the link to copy and the Desktop icon, never a multi-line Terminal recipe; that's what ytx replaced.
  • Links with &On Windows, a link with & (like watch?v=…&t=30s) can be cut at the & and print a stray error. Use the Desktop icon, ytx -p, or the youtu.be share link.
  • Reopen PowerShellAfter installing ytx.ps1, close and reopen PowerShell so the new ytx command is found.
  • Self-test FAILIf ytx -SelfTest shows FAIL, upload the files from the folder it names.
  • Garbled captionsAuto-captions mishear words. Treat quotes from them as approximate, not what the speaker actually said.

  • Internet on the computerThe Mac or PC needs to reach YouTube.
  • DashboardsCode execution on and the vibe-dashboard skill installed.

TermTopicDefinitionAppears inQty
ytxToolsSwami's command-line tool that wraps yt-dlp and cleans up its output: a Bash script on the Mac and ytx.ps1 on Windows.
ytx.ps1ToolsThe PowerShell port of ytx for Windows, with the same commands and output and an offline self-test.
yt-dlpToolsA free command-line downloader for YouTube and other sites; ytx uses it to fetch captions, chapters, details, and comments.
en-origVideoYouTube's original automatic English caption track. ytx 1.2.0 downloads it when the creator added no English subtitles.
HTTP 429Video"Too Many Requests": YouTube refusing a download for a while. ytx 1.1.0 hit it on the extra en caption track; 1.2.0 avoids it.
Desktop iconToolsThe double-click YouTube Transcript icon that runs ytx on the copied link and opens the result folder.
TerminalToolsThe macOS app for typing commands; used for the one-time install and for running ytx by hand.
PowerShellToolsWindows' command shell; runs ytx.ps1 and the install command.
wingetToolsWindows' built-in package manager; installs yt-dlp along with Deno and FFmpeg.
DenoToolsA JavaScript runtime yt-dlp can use; its missing-runtime warning doesn't affect transcripts.
transcript.mdFilesytx's main output: the transcript in ~20-second paragraphs under chapter headings, with linked timestamps.
transcript.txtFilesThe same transcript as plain text with [m:ss] stamps.
chapters.txtFilesOne line per chapter: time, title, and link. Missing when the video has no chapters.
.info.jsonFilesyt-dlp's file of the video's details (title, channel, date, length, description, chapters, and comments when asked).
Video folderFilesWhere ytx saves everything for one video: ~/yt/<video-id>/ on the Mac, %USERPROFILE%\yt\<video-id>\ on Windows.
ChapterVideoA titled section of a YouTube video, set by its creator, with a start time.
Timestamp linkVideoA link like youtu.be/<id>?t=<seconds> that opens the video at that moment.
Auto-captionsVideoYouTube's machine-made subtitles; ytx builds transcripts from them when there are no human ones, so they can contain misheard words.
VerbatimOutputWord for word. Only Swami's own videos get a full verbatim transcript.
Vibe dashboardOutputSwami's dark-theme single-page dashboard design; this skill can build one from a video.
Linked MacOutputA chat connected to Swami's Mac through the Claude desktop app, letting Claude run ytx there itself.
